tasks.command: python -c 'import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; path = ''D:\Download\File_template_BTL_2026.docx''; z = zipfile.ZipFile(path); root = ET.fromstring(z.read(''word/document.xml'')); ns = {''w'': ''http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main''}; style_attr = ''{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}val''; out = []; for par in root.iter(): if par.tag.endswith(''}p''): txt = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in par.iter() if t.tag.endswith(''}t'')).strip(); if txt: style = ''''; for child in par: if child.tag.endswith(''}pPr''): for c in child: if c.tag.endswith(''}pStyle''): style = c.get(style_attr) or ''''; break; out.append((style, txt)); for s,t in out[:80]: print(s, t[:200]); print(''TOTAL_PARAS'', len(out))'

tasks.command: $path='D:\Download\File_template_BTL_2026.docx'; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($path); $entry = $zip.GetEntry('word/document.xml'); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($entry.Open()); [xml]$doc = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $doc.SelectNodes('//*[local-name()="p"]') | ForEach-Object { $txt = ($_.SelectNodes('.//*[local-name()="t"]') | ForEach-Object { $_.InnerText }) -join ''; if ($txt) { $style = $_.SelectSingleNode('./*[local-name()="pPr"]/*[local-name()="pStyle"]/@val'); $styleName = if ($style) { $style.Value } else { '' }; [pscustomobject]@{Style=$styleName; Text=$txt} } } | Select-Object -First 80 | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: list-style-summary
tasks.command: [System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.IO.Compression.FileSystem') | Out-Null; $path='D:\Download\File_template_BTL_2026.docx'; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($path); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($zip.GetEntry('word/document.xml').Open()); [xml]$doc = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $styles = $doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes('//*') | Where-Object { $_.LocalName -eq 'p' } | ForEach-Object { $txt = ( $_.SelectNodes('.//*') | Where-Object { $_.LocalName -eq 't' } | ForEach-Object { $_.InnerText } ) -join ''; if ($txt) { $style = $_.SelectSingleNode('./*[local-name()="pPr"]/*[local-name()="pStyle"]/@val'); if ($style) { [pscustomobject]@{Style=$style.Value;Text=$txt} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Style='';Text=$txt} } } } | Group-Object Style | Sort-Object Count -Descending; $styles | Select-Object @{Name='Style';Expression={$_.Name}}, @{Name='Count';Expression={$_.Count}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: find-keywords
tasks.command: [System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.IO.Compression.FileSystem') | Out-Null; $path='D:\Download\File_template_BTL_2026.docx'; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($path); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($zip.GetEntry('word/document.xml').Open()); [xml]$doc = $reader.ReadToEnd(); $doc.DocumentElement.SelectNodes('//*') | Where-Object { $_.LocalName -eq 'p' } | ForEach-Object { $txt = ( $_.SelectNodes('.//*') | Where-Object { $_.LocalName -eq 't' } | ForEach-Object { $_.InnerText } ) -join ''; if ($txt) { $keywords = 'Mục lục','Lời mở đầu','Chương','Kết luận','Tài liệu tham khảo','Phụ lục','Lời cảm ơn','MỞ ĐẦU','CHƯƠNG','Phần','Mục','BÁO CÁO','ĐỀ TÀI'; $match = $false; foreach ($k in $keywords) { if ($txt.Contains($k)) { $match = $true; break } }; if ($match) { Write-Output $txt } } }
